title: Why this US town's only road out goes through Canada
description:
An American town of about 1,200 people has one road out, and it crosses into Canada. Twice, if you want to reach the rest of Washington. It happened because the 1846 treaty drew the border with a ruler along the 49th parallel, and nobody checked the coast.
